headline: Agram Legal, ELP act on Fraganote Series A fundraise
sum: Fraganote Fragrances Private Limited has raised ~$3 million from a Series A fundraise led by V Cube Ventures SA, with participation from existing investor Rukam Capital. Agram Legal Partners advised Fraganote on this fundraise.
detail: Fraganote Fragrances Private Limited has raised ~$3 million from a Series A fundraise led by V Cube Ventures SA, with participation from existing investor Rukam Capital. Agram Legal Partners advised Fraganote on this fundraise. The transaction was led by Khusnuma Nagwaswalla (Partner) and Suyash Bansal (Associate), with strategic inputs from Anshuman Singh (Partner). Economic Laws Practice (ELP) advised existing investor Rukam Capital on this fundraise.
